english: Your Attack level is used to determine how likely you are to hit your target in melee combat. A higher Attack level will give you a better chance to hit.
translation: Saldiri seviyeniz, yakin dövüste hedefinizi vurma olasiliginizi belirlemek icin kullanilir. Daha yüksek bir Saldiri seviyesi, vurma sansinizi artirir.

english: Additionally, a higher Attack level will allow you to wield more powerful weapons. A weapon with a higher Attack bonus will give you more accuracy in combat.
translation: Ayrica, daha yüksek bir Saldiri seviyesi, daha güclü silahlar kullanmaniza olanak tanir. Daha yüksek Saldiri bonusu olan bir silah, savasta size daha fazla isabet saglar.

english: You can select your Attack style from the Combat Options side panel. Different enemies are weaker or stronger against different Attack styles, so choose carefully.
translation: Saldiri stilinizi Savas Secenekleri yan panelinden secebilirsiniz. Farkli düsmanlar, farkli Saldiri stillerine karsi daha zayif veya daha güclüdür, bu yüzden dikkatli secin.

english: Cooking is a skill that lets you make all kinds of delicious food that will typically restore your Hitpoints, amongst providing other benefits.
translation: Ascilik, diger faydalarinin yani sira, genellikle Can Puaninizi yenileyen her türlü lezzetli yemegi yapmanizi saglayan bir beceridir.

english: At its most basic, Cooking can be done by simply taking raw meats and fish to either a fire or a range. You'll get better results overall if you use a range, though.
translation: En temel haliyle, Ascilik, cig et ve baliklari atese veya ocaga koyarak yapilabilir. Ancak, ocak kullanirsaniz genel olarak daha iyi sonuclar alirsiniz.

english: Some foods will require you to prepare your ingredients before you can cook them. For example, you first need to mix flour and water into a dough before you can bake them into bread.
translation: Bazi yiyecekleri pisirmeden önce malzemeleri hazirlamaniz gerekir. Örnegin, ekmek pisirmeden önce un ve suyu karistirarak hamur yapmaniz gerekir.

english: As your Cooking level increases, you'll get access to an increasing list of recipes. You'll also find that you accidentally burn your food less of the time as well.
translation: Ascilik seviyeniz arttikca, daha fazla tariflere erisebileceksiniz. Ayrica, yemeklerinizi yanlislikla yakma sikliginiz da azalacaktir.

english: Crafting is a wide-ranging skill that allows you to create various pieces of armour, jewellery, equipment and more.
translation: Zanaatkarlik, cesitli zirhlar, mücevherler, ekipmanlar ve daha fazlasini yaratmaniza olanak taniyan genis kapsamli bir beceridir.

english: To craft armour out of animal hides, you'll typically first need to take the hides to a tanner to get them tanned, then combine them with a needle and thread, which can be acquired from certain crafting shops in the world.
translation: Hayvan derilerinden zirh yapmak icin, genellikle önce derileri tabakciya götürüp tabaklamaniz, ardindan bunlari igne ve iplikle birlestirmeniz gerekir. Igne ve iplik, dünyadaki belirli zanaat dükkanlarindan temin edilebilir.

english: To make pottery, you'll need to obtain some soft clay, obtained by adding water to clay. You can then use a pottery wheel to shape the clay into an unfired item, which you can then finish in a pottery oven.
translation: Cömlek yapmak icin, kile su ekleyerek elde edilen yumusak kil gerekir. Daha sonra cömlek carki kullanarak kili pismemis bir nesneye dönüstürebilir ve ardindan cömlek firininda pisirebilirsiniz.

english: To make jewellery, you'll need to first get a crafting mould. You can then take that mould and some gold or silver bars to a furnace to craft your jewellery. At higher crafting levels, you can cut gems and mould them simultaneously to create jewellery which you can enchant!
translation: Taki yapmak icin önce bir zanaat kalibi edinmeniz gerekir. Daha sonra bu kalibi ve bazi altin veya gümüs cubuklari bir firina götürerek takilarinizi yapabilirsiniz. Daha yüksek zanaat seviyelerinde, mücevherleri kesip ayni anda kaliplayarak büyüleyebileceginiz takilar yapabilirsiniz!

english: Farming allows you to grow various flowers, vegetables, trees, herbs and more in farming patches across Gielinor.
translation: Ciftcilik, Gielinor'daki ciftlik arazilerinde cesitli cicekler, sebzeler, agaclar, otlar ve daha fazlasini yetistirmenizi saglar.

english: To get started, you'll need some seeds and a seed dibber, as well as a rake to de-weed the patch you want to use.
translation: Baslamak icin, tohumlar ve tohum ekme aleti ile kullanmak istediginiz araziyi temizlemek icin tirmik gerekir.

english: Once you've cleared the patch, you can add your seed to it. You can also optionally water it with a watering can or add a bucket of compost to decrease the chances of your plant becoming diseased.
translation: Arazinizi temizledikten sonra, tohumlarinizi ekebilirsiniz. Istege bagli olarak sulama kabi ile sulayabilirsiniz.

english: It'll take a while for your plant to grow, so feel free to explore the world and come back to it later!
translation: Bitkinizin büyümesi biraz zaman alacaktir, bu yüzden dünyayi kesfetmek icin zamaninizi ayirin ve daha sonra geri dönün!

english: Once your plant has grown, you might need another tool to collect the harvest. For instance, you'll need a shovel to dig up potatoes.
translation: Bitkiniz büyüdügünde, hasadi toplamak icin baska bir alete ihtiyaciniz olabilir. Örnegin, patatesleri kazmak icin bir kürek gerekir.

english: If you're worried about your crops becoming diseased, most crops can be protected by the nearby gardeners, but they'll want specific produce in return.

english: As your Farming level increases, you'll gain access to more crops to grow, as well as obtaining[sic] greater yields when harvesting.
translation: Ciftcilik seviyeniz arttikca, yetistirebileceginiz daha fazla mahsule erisim kazanacak ve hasat sirasinda daha fazla verim elde edeceksiniz.

english: You can now make Saradomin brew, use the Secondary Pouch, and make the Surge Potion.
Hitpoints are used to tell you how healthy your character is. A character who reaches 0 Hitpoints has died, but will reappear in their chosen respawn location (normally Lumbridge).

english: Magic grants you access to a wide variety of spells. To cast each spell, you will need a specific set of runes. You can see the runes required by inspecting the spell in either the spellbook side-panel, or in their tab in this guide.
translation: Büyü size çok çesitli büyülere erisim saglar. Her büyüyü yapmak için belirli bir rün setine ihtiyaciniz olacaktir. Gerekli rünleri büyü kitabi yan panelinde veya bu kilavuzdaki sekmelerinde büyüyü inceleyerek görebilirsiniz.

english: Click the spells in this guide to see the required runes to cast each spell. By opening the spellbook icon on the spellbook side-panel, you can see what each spell does by moving your mouse over its icon.
translation: Her bir büyüyü yapmak için gereken rünleri görmek için bu kilavuzdaki büyülere tiklayin. Büyü kitabi yan panelindeki büyü kitabi simgesini açarak, farenizi simgesinin üzerine getirerek her büyünün ne ise yaradigini görebilirsiniz.

english: You can use certain pieces of equipment to replace runes in order to cast spells. For instance, an equipped Staff of Air counts as an infinite supply of air runes.
translation: Büyü yapmak için belirli teçhizat parçalarini rünlerin yerine kullanabilirsiniz. Örnegin, donanimli bir Hava Asasi sonsuz hava rünü kaynagi olarak sayilir.

english: Mining allows you to get various minerals from the world, for use in other skills; primarily Smithing.
translation: Madencilik, diger becerilerde, özellikle de Smithing'de kullanmak üzere dünyadan cesitli mineraller elde etmenizi saglar.

english: To mine a rock, simply interact with it while holding a pickaxe you have the level to use and you'll start mining it. Eventually, you'll collect the ore and the rock will deplete. Low level rocks will replenish themselves fairly quickly, but higher level ones will take longer and longer to come back.
translation: Bir kayayi madencilige acmak icin, kullanabileceginiz seviyede bir kazma tutarken onunla etkilesime gecmeniz yeterlidir. Sonunda, cevheri toplarsiniz ve kaya tükenir. Düsük seviyeli kayalar oldukca hizli bir sekilde yenilenir, ancak yüksek seviyeli kayalarin yenilenmesi daha uzun sürer.

english: At higher mining levels, you'll have an increased chance of successfully mining a rock. You'll also be able to use more powerful pickaxes, which decrease the amount of time between mining attempts.
translation: Daha yüksek madencilik seviyelerinde, bir kayayi basarili bir sekilde madenciligi yapma sansiniz artar. Ayrica, madencilik denemeleri arasindaki süreyi azaltan daha güclü kazmalar kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Note that while most pickaxes have an Attack level requirement to equip them, you're still able to use them from within your inventory if you have the required Mining level.
translation: Cogu kazmanin donatilmasi icin Saldiri seviyesi gereksinimi olsa da, gerekli Madencilik seviyesine sahipseniz bunlari envanterinizden kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Prayer allows you to access different prayers, available from the Prayer side panel. Each prayer offers a different powerful benefit.
translation: Dua, Dua yan panelinden erisebileceginiz farkli dualara erismenizi saglar. Her dua farkli ve güclü faydalar sunar.

english: Using prayers will drain your prayer points over time. Once you run out of prayer points, you will be unable to use any prayers. You can restore your prayer points by praying at an altar.
translation: Dualari kullanmak zamanla dua puanlarinizi tüketir. Dua puanlariniz bittiginde, hicbir duayi kullanamazsiniz. Dua puanlarinizi bir sunakta dua ederek geri kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Some pieces of equipment will grant you a Prayer bonus, which will reduce the rate at which your prayer points are drained.
translation: Bazi ekipmanlar size Dua bonusu verir ve bu da dua puanlarinizin tükenme hizini azaltir.

english: The most common way to increase your Prayer level is to offer the remains of the enemies you kill. Burying their bones and scattering their ashes will award you Prayer experience.
translation: Dua seviyenizi artirmanin en yaygin yolu, öldürdügünüz düsmanlarin kalintilarini sunmaktir. Kemiklerini gömmek ve küllerini dagitmak size Dua deneyimi kazandirir.

english: Your Ranged level determines how accurate you are with ranged weapons, as well as how much damage they do. A higher Ranged level will result in more hits that do more damage.
translation: Menzilli seviyeniz, menzilli silahlarla ne kadar isabetli oldugunuzu ve bu silahlarin ne kadar hasar verdigini belirler. Daha yüksek bir Menzilli seviyesi, daha fazla hasar veren daha fazla vurusla sonuclanir.

english: Most ranged weapons will need a specific kind of ammunition to go with them; for instance, bows will need arrows and crossbows will need bolts.
translation: Cogu menzilli silah, kendilerine uygun belirli bir tür mühimmat gerektirir; örnegin, yaylar ok, tatar yaylari ise ok gerektirir.

english: As your Ranged level increases, you will also get access to more powerful weapons and ammunition. Typically, each ranged weapon can only handle ammo up to a certain level; for instance, an oak bow can only fire bronze, iron or steel arrows, but not mithril.
translation: Menzilli seviyeniz arttikca, daha güclü silah ve mühimmatlara da erisebileceksiniz. Genellikle, her menzilli silah belirli bir seviyeye kadar mühimmat kullanabilir; örnegin, mese yay sadece bronz, demir veya celik oklari atesleyebilir, ancak mithril oklari atesleyemez.

english: Runecrafting is the skill that allows you to convert essences into runes, which you can use to cast spells.
translation: Rün yapimi, özleri rünlere dönüstürmenizi saglayan beceridir. Rünleri büyü yapmak icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Runecrafting. Why not visit Aubury, who runs the rune shop in Varrock, where you can buy something special that is only available to true masters of the
translation: Tebrikler! Artik Runecrafting ustasi oldunuz. Varrock'ta rune dükkanini isleten Aubury'yi ziyaret ederek, sadece gercek rune yapimi ustalarinin sahip olabilecegi özel bir sey satin alabilirsiniz!

english: Runecrafting skill!
translation: Rune yapimi becerisi!

english: Runecraft is the skill that allows you to convert essences into runes, which you can use to cast spells.
translation: Runecraft, özleri büyü yapmak için kullanabileceginiz rünlere dönüstürmenizi saglayan beceridir.

english: Higher Runecraft levels will allow you to craft more kinds of runes. At higher levels, you'll also be able to make multiple runes per essence.
translation: Daha yüksek Runecraft seviyeleri, daha fazla türde rün üretmenize olanak tanir. Daha yüksek seviyelerde, öz basina birden fazla rün de yapabileceksiniz.

english: Slayer is a skill that lets you fight increasingly dangerous and lucrative monsters. Some monsters can only be fought if you have a high enough Slayer level.
translation: Slayer, giderek daha tehlikeli ve kazancli canavarlarla savasmaniza olanak taniyan bir beceridir. Bazi canavarlarla ancak yeterince yüksek Slayer seviyesine sahipseniz savasabilirsiniz.

english: To get started with Slayer, you'll first need a Slayer task, which can be obtained from a Slayer Master. You can then kill the assigned target to get Slayer experience.
translation: Slayer'a baslamak icin önce bir Slayer görevi almaniz gerekir. Bu görevi Slayer Master'dan alabilirsiniz. Ardindan, size verilen hedefi öldürerek Slayer deneyimi kazanabilirsiniz.

english: Once you've completed five tasks, you can start earning reward points, which can be used to skip or block tasks you don't want, or purchase various items and benefits like extended tasks.
translation: Bes görevi tamamladiginizda, ödül puanlari kazanmaya baslayabilirsiniz. Bu puanlari, istemediginiz görevleri atlamak veya engellemek ya da cesitli ögeler ve uzatilmis görevler gibi avantajlar satin almak icin kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Smithing lets you convert raw ores into useful metals, then use those metals to make your own weapons and armour.
translation: Smithing, ham cevherleri kullanisli metallere dönüstürmenizi ve bu metalleri kendi silah ve zirhlarinizi yapmak icin kullanmanizi saglar.

english: To smelt ores, simply take the mix of ores you need to any furnace and you'll be able to convert them into bars.
translation: Cevherleri eritmek icin, ihtiyaciniz olan cevher karisimini herhangi bir firina götürün ve bunlari cubuklara dönüstürebilirsiniz.

english: Once you have your bars, grab a hammer and take them to an anvil. Bigger items will need more bars to make.
translation: Cubuklarinizi aldiktan sonra, bir cekic alin ve bunlari bir örsün üzerine koyun. Daha büyük esyalar yapmak icin daha fazla cubuk gerekir.

english: As you advance your Smithing level, you'll be able to make more gear out of higher quality metals.
translation: Demircilik seviyeniz ilerledikce, daha yüksek kaliteli metallerden daha fazla ekipman yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Mithril Maces.
translation: Artik Mithril Maces yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Mithril Medium Helms and members can now make Mithril Crossbow Bolts and Shayzien platebodies (1).
translation: Artik Mithril Orta Migferler yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar artik Mithril Crossbow Bolts ve Shayzien platebodies (1) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Short Swords and members can make Mithril Dart Tips and Mithril Nails.
translation: Artik Mithril Kisa Kiliclar yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Mithril Dart Uclari ve Mithril Civiler yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Scimitars. Members can make Mithril Arrow Heads, Mithril Spears, Mithril Hastae and Shayzien gloves (2).
translation: Artik Mithril Kilici yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar Mithril Ok Uclari, Mithril Mizraklar, Mithril Hastae ve Shayzien eldivenleri (2) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Long Swords. Members can make Mithril Crossbow Limbs and Mithril Javelin Heads.
translation: Artik Mithril Uzun Kiliclar yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar Mithril Arbalet Kollari ve Mithril Cirit Uclari yapabilir.

translation: Artik Mithril Tam Migferler yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Mithril Firlatma Bicaklari ve Shayzien botlari (2) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Square Shields.
translation: Artik Mithril Kare Kalkanlar yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Mithril Warhammers and members can make Mithril Grapples and Shayzien helms (2).
translation: Artik Mithril Savas Cekicleri yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Mithril Kancalar ve Shayzien migferleri (2) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Battleaxes and Dragon square shields.
translation: Artik Mithril Savas Baltalari ve Ejderha kare kalkanlari yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Mithril Chainmail Bodies and members can make Shayzien greaves (2).
translation: Artik Mithril Zincir Panzeri yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Shayzien grevleri (2) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Kite Shields.
translation: Artik Mithril Ucurtma Kalkanlari yapabilirsiniz.

english: Members can now make Shayzien platebodies (2).
translation: Member'lar artik Shayzien zirh gövdeleri (2) yapabilir.

english: Members can now make Mithril Claws and Shayzien platebodies (2).
translation: Member'lar artik Mithril Penceleri ve Shayzien zirh gövdeleri (2) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Two Handed Swords.
translation: Artik Mithril Iki Elleri Kiliclar yapabilirsiniz.

english: Members can now make Shayzien gloves (3).
translation: Member'lar artik Shayzien eldivenleri (3) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Plate Legs, Mithril plate skirts and the Ancient Wyvern shield (with 66 magic).
translation: Artik Mithril Plaka Bacaklar, Mithril plaka etekler ve Eski Wyvern kalkani (66 büyü ile) yapabilirsiniz.

english: Members can now make Shayzien boots (3).
translation: Member'lar artik Shayzien botlari (3) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Mithril Plate Bodies.
translation: Artik Mithril Plaka Zirhlar yapabilirsiniz.

english: Members can now make Shayzien helms (3).
translation: Member'lar artik Shayzien migferleri (3) yapabilir.

english: You can now smelt Adamantite Ore and make Adamant Daggers and members can repair Zombie axes, make Crystal Helms and make Celestial Signets.
translation: Artik Adamantite Cevheri eritebilir ve Adamant Hancerleri yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar ise Zombie baltalarini onarabilir, Kristal Migferler ve Göksel Mühürler yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Axes and members can make Shayzien greaves (3) and reshape Crystal Felling Axes.
translation: Artik Adamant Baltalari yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar ise Shayzien grevleri (3) yapabilir ve Kristal Kesme Baltalarini yeniden sekillendirebilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Maces and members can make Crystal Legs and Noxious Halberds.
translation: Artik Adamant Maces yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar ise Kristal Bacaklar ve Zehirli Halberdler yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Medium Helms and members can make Adamantite Crossbow Bolts and Shayzien platebodies (3).
translation: Artik Adamant Orta Migferler yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Adamantit Arbalet Oklari ve Shayzien zirh gövdeleri (3) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Short Swords and members can make Adamant Dart Tips, Adamant Nails,the Emberlight and Crystal Bodies.
translation: Artik Adamant Kisa Kiliclar yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Adamant Dart Uclari, Adamant Civiler, Emberlight ve Kristal Gövdeler yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Scimitars. Members can make Adamant Arrow Heads, Adamant Spears, Adamant Hastae, Shayzien gloves (4), Dragon kiteshields and Sturdy harnesses.
translation: Artik Adamant Scimitars yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar Adamant Arrow Heads, Adamant Spears, Adamant Hastae, Shayzien eldivenleri (4), Dragon kiteshields ve Sturdy harnesses yapabilirler.

english: You can now make Adamant Long Swords. Members can make Adamant Crossbow Limbs, Adamant Javelin Heads and Crystal Tools.
translation: Artik Adamant Long Swords yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar Adamant Crossbow Limbs, Adamant Javelin Heads ve Crystal Tools yapabilirler.

english: You can now make Adamant Full Helms and members can make Adamant Throwing Knives and Shayzien boots (4).
translation: Artik Adamant Tam Migferler yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Adamant Firlatma Bicaklari ve Shayzien botlari (4) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Square Shields, Crystal Bows, Crystal Halberds and Crystal Shields.
translation: Artik Adamant Kare Kalkanlar, Kristal Yaylar, Kristal Halberdler ve Kristal Kalkanlar yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Adamant Warhammers and members can make Shayzien helms (4).
translation: Artik Adamant Savas Cekicleri yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Shayzien migferleri (4) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Battleaxes, Godsword blades, enhanced crystal keys and eternal teleport crystals.
translation: Artik Adamant Savas Baltalari, Godsword kiliclari, gelistirilmis kristal anahtarlar ve ebedi teleport kristalleri yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Adamant Chainmail Bodies and members can make Shayzien greaves (4).
translation: Artik Adamant Zincir Panzeri gövdeleri yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Shayzien greaves (4) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Kite Shields and members can make Blades of Saeldor and Bows of Faerdhinen.
translation: Artik Adamant Kite Kalkanlari yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Saeldor Kiliclari ve Faerdhinen Yaylari yapabilir.

english: Members can now make Adamant Claws and Shayzien platebodies (4).
translation: Member'lar artik Adamant Penceleri ve Shayzien zirh gövdeleri (4) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Two Handed Swords.
translation: Artik Adamant Iki Ellik Kiliclar yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now smelt Runite Ore and make Rune Daggers. Members can attach Sigils to Blessed Spirit Shields, create infernal pickaxes, make Shayzien gloves (5) and the Ursine Chainmace.
translation: Artik Runite Cevheri eritebilir ve Rune Hancerleri yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar, Kutsanmis Ruh Kalkanlarina Sigiller ekleyebilir, cehennem kazmalari olusturabilir, Shayzien eldivenleri (5) ve Ursine Zincir Mizraklari yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Plate Legs, Adamant plate skirts and Rune Axes.
translation: Artik Adamant Zirhli Bacaklar, Adamant zirhli etekler ve Rune Baltalari yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Rune Maces and members can make Shayzien boots (5).
translation: Artik Rune Maces yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Shayzien botlari (5) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Adamant Plate Bodies and Rune Medium Helms and members can make Runite Crossbow Bolts.
translation: Artik Adamant Plate Bodies ve Rune Medium Helms yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Runite Crossbow Bolts yapabilir.

english: You can now make Rune Short Swords. Members can make Rune Dart Tips, Rune Nails and Shayzien helms (5).
translation: Artik Rune Short Swords yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar Rune Dart Tips, Rune Nails ve Shayzien kasklari (5) yapabilir.

english: You can now make Rune Scimitars and members can make Rune Arrow Heads, Rune Spears, Rune Hastae, Dragonfire shields, Dragonfire wards, Dragon platebodies, Torva armour and Elidinis' ward.
translation: Artik Rune Scimitars yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Rune Arrow Heads, Rune Spears, Rune Hastae, Dragonfire shields, Dragonfire wards, Dragon platebodies, Torva armour ve Elidinis' ward yapabilirler.

english: You can now make Rune Long Swords. Members can make Rune Crossbow Limbs, Rune Javelin Heads and Shayzien greaves (5).
translation: Artik Rune Uzun Kiliclari yapabilirsiniz. Member'lar Rune Arbalet Kollari, Rune Cirit Basliklari ve Shayzien grevleri (5) yapabilirler.

english: You can now make Rune Full Helms and members can make Rune Throwing Knives.
translation: Artik Rune Tam Migferleri yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Rune Firlatma Bicaklari yapabilirler.

english: You can now make Rune Square Shields and members can make Shayzien platebodies (5).
translation: Artik Rune Kare Kalkanlari yapabilirsiniz ve Member'lar Shayzien zirhlari (5) yapabilirler.

english: You can now make Rune Warhammers.
translation: Artik Rune Savas Cekicleri yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Rune Battleaxes.
translation: Artik Rune Savas Baltalari yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Rune Chainmail Bodies.
translation: Artik Rune Zincir Panzeri yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now make Rune Kite Shields.
translation: Artik Rune Ucurtma Kalkanlari yapabilirsiniz.

english: Members can now make Rune Claws.
translation: Member'lar artik Rune Penceleri yapabilir.

english: Congratulations! You are now a master smith. Why not visit Thurgo, who lives near Mudskipper Point? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Smithing skill!
translation: Tebrikler! Artik usta bir demircisiniz. Mudskipper Point yakinlarinda yasayan Thurgo'yu ziyaret etmeye ne dersiniz? Onda, sadece gercek demircilik ustalarinin sahip olabilecegi özel bir sey var!

english: Your Strength level determines your max hit in combat. Whenever you hit your opponent, you will deal a random amount of damage up to your max hit.
translation: Güc seviyeniz, savasta maksimum vurusunuzu belirler. Rakibinize vurdugunuzda, maksimum vurusunuza kadar rastgele bir miktar hasar verirsiniz.

english: Most weapons have a Strength bonus that will also increase your max hit. You can view your Strength bonus (and all of your equipment's stats) by selecting 'View equipment stats' under the Worn Equipment side panel.
translation: Cogu silahin, maksimum vurusunuzu da artiran bir Güc bonusu vardir. Güc bonusunuzu (ve tüm ekipmaninizin istatistiklerini) Takili Ekipman yan panelinden “Ekipman istatistiklerini görüntüle” secenegini secerek görüntüleyebilirsiniz.

english: You can now wield Steel Warhammers. Members can now wield Black Halberds and White Halberds.
translation: Artik Celik Savas Cekicleri kullanabilirsiniz. Member'lar artik Siyah Halberdler ve Beyaz Halberdler kullanabilir.

english: You can now wield Black Warhammers. Members can now wield White Warhammers, and Mithril Halberds.
translation: Artik Siyah Savas Cekicleri kullanabilirsiniz. Member'lar artik Beyaz Savas Cekicleri ve Mithril Halberdler kullanabilir.

english: Members can now wield Adamant Halberds.
translation: Member'lar artik Adamant Halberdler kullanabilir.

english: You can now wield Mithril Warhammers. Members can now wield Rune Halberds.
translation: Artik Mithril Savas Cekicleri kullanabilirsiniz. Member'lar artik Rune Halberdler kullanabilir.

english: You can now wield Adamant Warhammers.
translation: Artik Adamant Savas Cekicleri kullanabilirsiniz.

english: You can now wield Rune Warhammers.
translation: Artik Rune Savas Cekicleri kullanabilirsiniz.

english: Members can now wield Void Knight equipment!
translation: Member'lar artik Void Knight ekipmanlarini kullanabilir!

english: Members can now wield Granite armour and the Granite hammer & maul.
translation: Member'lar artik Granit zirhi ve Granit cekic ve balyozu kullanabilir.

english: Members can now wield Dragon Warhammers and the Ancient Sceptre, and access the God Wars Dungeon via the Strength shortcut.
translation: Member'lar artik Ejderha Savas Cekicleri ve Kadim Asayi kullanabilir ve Güc kisayolu ile Tanri Savaslari Zindanina erisebilir.

english: Members can access the Bandos area in the God Wars Dungeon and wear Inquisitor's Armour.
translation: Member'lar, God Wars Dungeon'daki Bandos bölgesine erisebilir ve Inquisitor's Armour giyebilir.

english: Members can wield the Abyssal bludgeon, access the Bandos area in the God Wars Dungeon and wear Inquisitor's Armour.
translation: Member'lar, Abyssal bludgeon kullanabilir, God Wars Dungeon'daki Bandos bölgesine erisebilir ve Inquisitor's Armour giyebilir.

english: Members can now equip Primordial boots!
translation: Member'lar artik Primordial botlarini giyebilir!

english: Members can now equip the Soulreaper axe!
translation: Member'lar artik Soulreaper baltasini giyebilir!

english: Members can now equip the Scythe of vitur!
translation: Member'lar artik Scythe of vitur'u giyebilir!

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Strength. Why not visit [Sloane/Yadech Strongarm] at the Warriors' Guild? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Strength skill!
translation: Tebrikler! Artik Strength ustasi oldunuz. Warriors' Guild'deki [Sloane/Yadech Strongarm]'i ziyaret etmeye ne dersiniz? Orada, Strength becerisinin gercek ustalarina özel bir sey var!

english: Thieving lets you steal items from various people and stalls. Be careful, as people won't take too kindly to you going through their pockets, and might call the guards on you, or may take matters into their own hands.
translation: Thieving, cesitli kisilerden ve tezgahlardan esya calmaniza olanak tanir. Dikkatli olun, cünkü insanlar ceplerini karistirmaniza pek hos bakmayabilir ve sizi muhafizlara sikayet edebilir veya kendi baslarina harekete gecebilirler.

english: As your Thieving level increases, the odds of you successfully stealing from your target will increase. You will also gain access to more lucrative targets with more valuable loot.
translation: Hirsizlik seviyeniz arttikca, hedefinizden basarili bir sekilde calma sansiniz da artacaktir. Ayrica, daha degerli ganimetler iceren daha kazancli hedeflere erisim elde edeceksiniz.

english: You can now steal from Cake Stalls, Tea Stalls, Crafting Stalls and Monkey Food Stalls!
translation: Artik Kek Tezgahlari, Cay Tezgahlari, El Sanatlari Tezgahlari ve Maymun Yemi Tezgahlarindan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Farmers!
translation: Artik Ciftcilerden yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from certain chests in Ardougne, Rellekka and the Wilderness!
translation: Artik Ardougne, Rellekka ve Vahsi Doga'daki belirli sandiklardan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from HAM followers and steal cowbells from Dairy Cows!
translation: Artik HAM takipcilerinden yankesicilik yapabilir ve süt ineklerinden can calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from Silk Stalls and pick locks on Zogre coffins at Jiggig.
translation: Artik Ipek Tezgahlarindan calabilir ve Jiggig'deki Zogre tabutlarinin kilitlerini acabilirsiniz.

english: You can now enter the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from Wine Stalls!
translation: Artik Sarap Tezgahlarindan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Warriors, steal from Fruit Stalls and enter the sorceress's Spring garden!
translation: Artik Savascilardan yankesicilik yapabilir, Meyve Tezgahlarindan calabilir ve büyücünün Bahar bahcesine girebilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from Seed Stalls!
translation: Artik tohum tezgahlarindan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from certain chests upstairs in Ardougne, in Rellekka and on the Isle of Souls!
translation: Artik Ardougne, Rellekka ve Ruhlar Adasi'ndaki üst kattaki belirli sandiklardan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Villagers!
translation: Artik köylülerden yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the second room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin ikinci odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now pickpocket from Rogues!
translation: Artik haydutlardan yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from Fur Stalls!
translation: Artik kürk tezgahlarindan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket Cave Golbins and steal from chests in Aldarin Villas!
translation: Artik Magara Golbinlerinin cebinden para calabilir ve Aldarin Villalari'ndaki sandiklardan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Master Farmers!
translation: Artik Usta Ciftcilerin cebinden para calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from City Guards!
translation: Artik Sehir Muhafizlarinin cebinden para calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the third room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin ücüncü odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from Fish Stalls!
translation: Artik Balik Tezgahlarindan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from certain chests upstairs in Ardougne!
translation: Artik Ardougne'deki üst kattaki belirli sandiklardan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from the Dorgeshuun wire machine!
translation: Artik Dorgeshuun tel makinesinden calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Fremenniks, bearded bandit thugs in Pollnivneach and enter the sorceress's Autumn garden!
translation: Artik Fremenniklerden, Pollnivneach'teki sakalli haydut cetelerinden yankesicilik yapabilir ve büyücünün Sonbahar bahcesine girebilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from certain chests in Hemenster and Rellekka with the aid of a lockpick!
translation: Artik Hemenster ve Rellekka'daki belirli sandiklardan kilit acma aleti yardimiyla calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from Crossbow Stalls and pick locks in Port Piscarilius with the aid of a lockpick!
translation: Artik Port Piscarilius'ta tatar yay tezgahlarindan calabilir ve kilit acma aleti yardimiyla kilitleri acabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Wealthy Citizens, steal from Silver Stalls, crack Wall Safes in Rogues' Den, and Rob houses in Civitas illa Fortis!
translation: Artik zengin vatandaslarin cebinden hirsizlik yapabilir, gümüs tezgahlarindan calabilir, Rogues' Den'deki duvar kasalarini kirabilir ve Civitas illa Fortis'teki evleri soyabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the fourth room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin dördüncü odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from average chests in Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: Artik Dorgesh-Kaan'daki ortalama sandiklardan calabilirsiniz.

english: You can now pickpocket from Desert Bandits!
translation: Artik cöl haydutlarinin cebinden hirsizlik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Knights of Ardougne and Bandits in Pollnivneach!
translation: Artik Pollnivneach'teki Ardougne Sövalyeleri ve Haydutlardan yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pick-lock the door to the Grubby Chest in the Forthos Dungeon!
translation: Artik Forthos Zindanindaki Grubby Sandiginin kapisini kilit acma aletiyle acabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from chests under the Chaos Druid Tower near Ardougne!
translation: Artik Ardougne yakinlarindaki Kaos Druid Kulesi'nin altindaki sandiklardan calabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the fifth room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin besinci odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from chests in the Lizardman Temple.
translation: Artik Lizardman Tapinagi'ndaki sandiklardan calabilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from Spice Stalls, Magic Stalls and Scimitar Stalls, pickpocket from Watchmen and Menaphite thugs and enter the sorceress's Summer garden!
translation: Artik Baharat Tezgahlari, Büyü Tezgahlari ve Kilic Tezgahlari'ndan calabilir, Watchmen ve Menaphite haydutlarindan hirsizlik yapabilir ve büyücünün Yaz bahcesine girebilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from coffins within The Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Artik The Hallowed Sepulchre'deki tabutlardan calabilirsiniz.

english: You can now pickpocket from Paladins!
translation: Artik Paladinlerden hirsizlik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the sixth room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin altinci odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from certain chests in the castle in Ardougne!
translation: Artik Ardougne'daki kalede belirli sandiklardan hirsizlik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from Gem Stalls and pickpocket from Gnomes!
translation: Artik Mücevher Tezgahlarindan hirsizlik yapabilir ve Gnome'lardan yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from rich chests in Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: Artik Dorgesh-Kaan'daki zengin sandiklardan hirsizlik yapabilirsiniz.

english: You can now pickpocket from Heroes!
translation: Artik Kahramanlardan yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the seventh room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin yedinci odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: You can now steal from Ore Stalls and pickpocket from Vyres!
translation: Artik Cevher Tezgahlarindan calabilir ve Vyres'lerden yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now steal from chests at the Rogues' Castle.
translation: Artik Rogues' Castle'daki sandiklardan calabilirsiniz.

english: You can now pickpocket from Elves!
translation: Artik Elflerden yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now pickpocket from Tzhaar!
translation: Artik Tzhaar'dan yankesicilik yapabilirsiniz!

english: You can now enter the eigth and final room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: Artik Sophanem'deki Jalsavrah mezarlarinin sekizinci ve son odasina girebilirsiniz.

english: Congratulations! You are now a master thief. Why not visit Martin Thwait who runs a shop at the Rogues' Den, where you can buy something special that is only available to true masters of the Thieving skill!
translation: Tebrikler! Artik usta bir hirsizsiniz. Rogues' Den'de dükkan isleten Martin Thwait'i ziyaret ederek, Hirsizlik becerisinin gercek ustalarina özel bir sey satin alabilirsiniz!

english: Woodcutting allows you to chop down trees to obtain logs. Most trees in the game can be chopped down with an axe.
translation: Odun kesme, agaclari keserek kütük elde etmenizi saglar. Oyundaki cogu agac balta ile kesilebilir.

english: Increasing your Woodcutting level will give you a higher chance of successfully chopping a tree. You'll also gain access to more trees to cut down.
translation: Odunculuk seviyenizi artirmak size basarili bir sekilde agaç kesme sansi verecektir. Ayrica kesmek için daha fazla agaca erisim kazanacaksiniz.

english: In addition to this, higher Woodcutting levels grant access to more powerful axes, which also increase the chance of chopping trees. Note that you can still use an axe in your inventory if you have the Woodcutting level for it, even if you don't have the Attack level to equip it.
translation: Buna ek olarak, daha yüksek Odunculuk seviyeleri daha güçlü baltalara erisim saglar ve bu da agaç kesme sansini artirir. Envanterinizde Odunculuk seviyesine sahip bir balta varsa, onu kusanacak Saldiri seviyesine sahip olmasaniz bile baltayi kullanmaya devam edebileceginizi unutmayin.

english: You can now chop with a Steel Axe and members can now chop with a Steel Felling Axe.
translation: Artik Çelik Balta ile agaç kesebilirsiniz ve üyeler artik Çelik Kesim Baltasi ile agaç kesebilir.

english: Members can now cut down Light Jungle.
translation: Üyeler artik Hafif Ormani kesebilir.

english: You can now chop with a Black Axe and members can now chop with a Black Felling Axe.
translation: Artik bir Kara Balta ile kesebilirsiniz ve üyeler artik bir Kara Keser Balta ile kesebilir.

english: You can now make and paddle a Log Canoe.
translation: Artik bir Kütük Kano yapabilir ve kürek çekebilirsiniz.

english: You can now cut down Oak Trees.
translation: Artik Mese Agaçlarini kesebilirsiniz.

english: There is new information available from the Woodcutting Tutor in Lumbridge.
translation: Lumbridge'deki Odunculuk Egitmeninden yeni bilgiler edinebilirsiniz.

english: Members can now cut down Medium Jungle.
translation: Üyeler artik Orta Boy Ormanlari kesebilir.

english: You can now chop with a Mithril Axe and members can now chop with a Mithril Felling Axe.
translation: Artik bir Mithril Balta ile kesebilirsiniz ve üyeler artik bir Mithril Kesim Baltasi ile kesebilir.

english: You can now make and paddle a Dugout Canoe.
translation: Artik bir Dugout Kano yapabilir ve kürek çekebilirsiniz.

english: You can now cut down Willow Trees.
translation: Artik Sögüt Agaçlarini kesebilirsiniz.

english: You can now chop with an Adamant Axe and members can now chop with an Adamant Felling Axe.
translation: Artik bir Adamant Baltasi ile kesebilirsiniz ve üyeler artik bir Adamant Kesim Baltasi ile kesebilir.

english: Members can now cut down Dense Jungle and Teak Trees and craft Forester's Rations, Secateurs Attachments and Bees on a Stick.
translation: Üyeler artik Sik Orman ve Tik Agaçlarini kesebilir ve Ormanci Tayinlari, Budama Makasi Ekleri ve Çubuktaki Arilar üretebilir.

english: You can now chop with a Rune Axe and Gilded Axe, and members can now chop with a Rune Felling Axe.
translation: Artik bir Rün Baltasi ve Yaldizli Balta ile kesebilirsiniz ve üyeler artik bir Rün Kesim Baltasi ile kesebilirler.

english: You can now make and paddle a Stable Dugout Canoe and members can cut down Juniper Trees.
translation: Artik bir Ahir Siginagi Kanosu yapabilir ve kürek çekebilirsiniz ve üyeler Ardiç Agaçlarini kesebilir.

english: Members can now wear the Undead Lumberjack clothing.
translation: Üyeler artik Ölümsüz Oduncu kiyafeti giyebilir.

english: You can now cut down Maple Trees and members can cut down Hollow Trees.
translation: Artik Akçaagaç Agaçlarini kesebilirsiniz ve üyeler Oyuk Agaçlari kesebilir.

english: Members can now cut down Mahogany Trees and craft Clothes Pouches and Petal Circlets.
translation: Üyeler artik Maun Agaçlarini kesebilir ve Kiyafet Keseleri ve Petal Çemberleri üretebilir.

english: Members can now cut down arctic pine.
translation: Üyeler artik kutup çami kesebilir.

english: Members can now split arctic pine logs and make Fremennik round shields.
translation: Üyeler artik kutup çami kütüklerini yarabilir ve Fremennik yuvarlak kalkanlari yapabilir.

english: You can now make and paddle a Waka Canoe.
translation: Artik bir Waka Kanosu yapabilir ve kürek çekebilirsiniz.

english: You can now cut down Yew Trees.
translation: Artik Porsuk Agaçlarini kesebilirsiniz.

english: Members can now chop logs from the Blisterwood Tree.
translation: Üyeler artik Kabarcik Agaci'ndan kütük kesebilir.

english: Members can now chop Sulliuscep mushrooms on Fossil Island.

english: Members can now craft Nature offerings.
translation: Üyeler artik Doga sunulari üretebilir.

english: Members can now cut down Magic Trees and craft Sturdy Harnesses.
translation: Üyeler artik Sihirli Agaçlari kesebilir ve Saglam Kosumlar üretebilir.

english: Members can now chop Redwood Trees.
translation: Üyeler artik Kizilagaç Agaçlarini kesebilir.

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Woodcutting. Why not visit Wilfred, near Lumbridge, who has something special that is only available to true masters of the Woodcutting skill!
translation: Tebrikler! Artik bir Odunculuk ustasisiniz. Lumbridge yakinlarindaki Wilfred'i ziyaret etmeye ne dersiniz? Wilfred'de sadece Odunculuk becerisinin gerçek ustalarina sunulan özel bir sey var!

english: Increasing your Woodcutting level will give you a higher chance of successfully chopping a tree. You'll also gain access to more trees to cut down.
translation: Odun Kesme seviyenizi artirdiginizda, bir agaci basariyla kesme sansiniz artar. Ayrica kesebileceginiz daha fazla agaca erisim kazanirsiniz.

english: In addition to this, higher Woodcutting levels grant access to more powerful axes, which also increase the chance of chopping trees. Note that you can still use an axe in your inventory if you have the Woodcutting level for it, even if you don't have the Attack level to equip it.
translation: Buna ek olarak, daha yüksek Odun Kesme seviyeleri daha güclü baltalara erisim saglar ve bu da agaclari kesme sansinizi artirir. Odun Kesme seviyeniz yeterliyse, Saldiri seviyeniz yeterli olmasa bile envanterinizdeki baltayi kullanabilirsiniz.
